title: Kane-Mele model: shift current across the topological transition
summary: The shift current of the Kane-Mele model with a staggered potential, spin-orbit and Rashba coupling, on both sides of the quantum-spin-Hall / trivial transition (delta = 0.5 and 1.5 times 3 sqrt(3) lambda_SO). No DFT run.

steps.label: Shift current in the QSH and trivial phases
steps.note: two 300 x 300 runs; writes output_qsh/ and output_trivial/
